# OnlyJobs

> OnlyJobs is an AI job matcher for job seekers in the United States. Instead of a giant job board, it sends you a few explained matches a day - each with a score, why it fits you, and what didn't - and charges only on days a match clears your bar. No subscription.

## What it is (and isn't)
- OnlyJobs is an AI job matcher, not a job board. It does not publish public job-listing or category pages; you get private, scored matches after profiling.
- It never applies for you. There is no auto-apply - you review every match and apply yourself.

## How it works
1. Upload your resume.
2. Answer open-ended questions by voice or text - your work stories and what you want. The more you share, the sharper the matches.
3. Set your preferences and a match-score threshold (in Settings).
4. Once a day, OnlyJobs checks new jobs from a curated set of quality remote boards and scores each against your profile.
5. Only jobs above your threshold reach you - each with a score, why it fits, and what didn't (why you might not like it, and why the score isn't higher). Drafted answers are included when a listing has application questions.

## Key facts
- **Category**: AI job matcher for US job seekers
- **Coverage**: mainly remote roles, plus some hybrid; tech and non-tech (support, finance, marketing, sales, operations, admin, and more)
- **Cadence**: once a day. No auto-apply.
- **Profiling**: open-ended Q&A by voice or text
- **Operator**: Aurora Designs LLP, Bangalore, India
- **Website**: https://onlyjobs.app
- **Contact**: contact@auroradesignshq.com

## Pricing
- No subscription. It is a prepaid wallet.
- $2 of free credit on signup (about six match days). No card required.
- $0.30 charged once on any day at least one match clears your threshold; $0 on days nothing clears. A stricter threshold means fewer charged days.
- Top up $5, $10, or $20, or a custom amount. Funds do not expire. Pause matching any time and keep your balance.

## What makes it different
- Every match tells you **what didn't fit** - not just why a job matches, but what you might dislike about it and why the score isn't higher. It is how you can tell the tool understood you.
- Fewer, explained matches instead of volume or auto-apply.
- No subscription - you pay only on days it finds you a match that clears your bar.

## Definitions
- **Match day**: a calendar day when at least one job clears your threshold. You are charged $0.30 once on a match day, nothing on other days.
- **Threshold**: the minimum match score you set. Jobs below it are not sent and do not trigger a charge.
- **What didn't fit**: part of every match's explanation - the reasons a role may not suit you and why its score isn't higher.
- **Not a job board**: OnlyJobs does not publish public job listings or category pages; seekers get private daily matches after profiling.

- [Sample match report](https://onlyjobs.app/sample-match-report): an illustrative example of a day's matches - three jobs, each with why it fits and what didn't, plus pricing. The best page to understand the product before signing up.
- [How it works](https://onlyjobs.app/how-it-works): the matching process end to end, the definitions above, pricing, and FAQs.
- [About](https://onlyjobs.app/about): why the founder built OnlyJobs after his own layoff, and why there is no subscription.

- [Blog](https://onlyjobs.app/blog): first-person notes on job-hunting without the grind.

  - [Job search burnout is real](https://onlyjobs.app/blog/job-search-burnout): applying to fewer jobs on purpose.
